description: Find the factorial of a given number n.
hints: [{"hint": "Factorial of n is n * (n-1) * ... * 1."}, {"hint": "Use recursion or a loop; use a 64-bit type since factorials grow fast."}]

description: Given an array of n integers and a target value, find two distinct indices i and j such that arr[i] + arr[j] equals target. Print the two indices separated by a space, smaller index first. Exactly one valid pair exists. Input format: line 1 is n, line 2 has n space-separated integers, line 3 is target.
hints: [{"hint": "Use a hash map to store each value's index as you scan."}, {"hint": "For each element check if target minus that element was already seen."}]

description: Given an integer x, determine whether it is a palindrome (reads the same forward and backward). Print 1 if it is a palindrome, 0 otherwise. Negative numbers are never palindromes.
hints: [{"hint": "Convert to a string and compare it with its reverse."}, {"hint": "Negative numbers can never be palindromes because of the minus sign."}]

description: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid (every open bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order). Print 1 if valid, 0 otherwise.
hints: [{"hint": "Use a stack: push opening brackets, and on a closing bracket check the top of the stack matches."}, {"hint": "An empty string is considered valid."}]

description: Given an array of n integers, find the sum of the contiguous subarray with the largest sum, and print that sum. Input format: line 1 is n, line 2 has n space-separated integers.
hints: [{"hint": "Use Kadane's Algorithm: track a running sum and reset it when it drops below the current element."}, {"hint": "The answer can be negative if all elements are negative."}]
